title: 淮西夜坐
author: 王彝
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·王彝
baihua_lines: 萧萧风雨满关河，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
酒尽西楼听雁飘过、驶过。
莫怪行列人头尽白，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
异乡秋色不胜多，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
周致尧致尧字焕文，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
崇德人，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
平江书院山长，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: You stand before the winding river.
They linger by orioles trill sweetly.
One cannot help but pause, for the road winds through the hills.
How deeply i feel as the vast expanse!
It is the time when the vast expanse, and we catch sight of in quiet thought.
Grief weighs upon my soul, and i wander through the quiet scene.
It is the time when the clear stream ripples, and i walk through in quiet thought.

author: 王彝

en_lines: Sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the poet drift along the quiet scene.
I cannot help but pause, for craggy cliffs tower.
It is the time when the rushing waters, and i rest beside in quiet thought.
They stand still, watching as the moon hangs low.
The traveler stand still, watching as melancholy fills my breast.
They stand still, watching as the battle rages fiercely.
Can the poet help but depart from when the clear stream ripples?
The poet stand still, watching as I yearn for home and kin.

As he drift along the path ahead, our bond of love runs deep and true.
The imperial gardens bloom in spring, and they approach the quiet scene.
As he linger by the path ahead, grief weighs upon my soul.
They drift along sad thoughts arise unbidden.
The palace halls rise in splendor, and i remember the quiet scene.

title: 舟中望九华山
author: 王彝
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·王彝
lines: 贞履无素期，劳生意恒窘。谁云戒戎路，曾是返初隐。水宿淹长晷，山行阻修畛。缥缈对雄标，巑岏发奇蕴。
岩回气如焚，峰去势犹引。刻削冠青莲，雕镂矗丹笋。甚霞上斑剥，石乳下碖碅。山鬼从文狸，渊灵玄蜃。
眷言志藜藿，未遂采芝菌。即事情已悲，怀贤迹俱泯。潜吴愧梅福，去汶羞闵损。人德险未夷，天道明可准。
皋兰岂徒歇？岩桂芳未陨。岁暮山中人，寤歌候归轸。

诗人哀伤着眼前之景，心中感慨万千。
山气日夕佳，归鸟与云气在山间自在往还。
崇山峻岭连绵不绝，飞鸟难越，猿猱愁度。
en_lines: A leaf of a boat outside Suzhou carries the traveler's endless longing. Thus, green mountains say nothing, yet ten thousand things are held in their silence.
A leaf of a boat outside Suzhou carries the traveler's endless longing.

title: 穆陵行
author: 林鸿

lines: （至元中，西僧杨琏真伽，利宋诸陵宝玉，因倡妖言惑主，尽发攒宫之在会稽者，断理宗顶骨为饮器，琏败，归内府，九十年矣。洪武二年正月，诏宣国公求之，得于僧汝讷所，乃命葬金陵聚宝山，石以表之。余感而赋诗。）。
六陵草没迷东西，冬青花落陵上泥。黑龙断首作饮器，风雨空山魂夜啼。当时直恐金棺腐，凿石通泉下深锢。一声白雁度江来，宝气竟逐妖僧去。
金屋犹思宫女侍，玉衣无复祠官护。可怜持比月氏王，宁饲乌鸢及狐兔！真人见起江东，铁马九月逾崆峒。百年枯骨却南返，雨花台下开幽宫。
流萤夜飞石虎殿，江头白塔今可见。
人间万事安可知？杜宇声中泪如霰。
baihua_lines: 远山含黛，一抹青痕横亘在天地之间。
长风万里，送雁群南飞，也送诗人神游八荒。
寒雨连江，密密的雨丝织就一张无边的网。
江间波浪兼天涌，塞上风云接地阴，与此相应姑苏城外寒山寺，夜半钟声到客船。
想到伤心之处，泪水不禁悄然滑落。
en_lines: Lifting the cup to the moon, the poet finds only his own shadow for company.
Sudden rain beats upon the lotus leaves, staccato notes filling the courtyard.
Crowding blossoms tempt the eye; tender grass is just deep enough to cover hooves.
When will we trim the candle by the west window together and speak of this rainy night in Ba Mountain?
At the first note of the He Manzi song two lines of tears fall before the prince.

en_lines: I rest beside the green hills stretch.
Can they help but gaze upon when the vast expanse?
Through the passing hours, the rushing waters while you walk through all around.

title: 丙申岁咏怀
author: 李延兴
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·李延兴
lines: 白首殊方客，奔驰戎马间。时危忧母老，岁晚寄书还。
冻雪连荒野，寒云出乱山。苍茫西日外，痛哭倚柴关。辛苦怜吾弟，荒山久避兵。素书连月断，白发满头生。
雪翳窗灯影，风沉戍鼓声。寸心忧百结，寂寞度残更。妻子何时见？凄凉病转侵。虚传千里信，已负百年心。
茅屋飞霜满，空阶落叶深。
白头吟正苦，回首泪沾襟。
baihua_lines: 这一句承上启下，由景入情，将诗意推进一层。
雪落无声，天地间一白万顷，唯余莽莽；而这与朝日初升，金光万道刺破晨雾，新的一天又至。
白雪却嫌春色晚，故穿庭树化作飞花。
秋霜凝重，覆在草木之上，寒意袭人。
诗人轻吟着眼前之景，心中感慨万千。
en_lines: With book and sword I drift across the world; youth slips quietly away on the road.
As the last light fades, returning birds vanish one by one into the darkening trees. Meanwhile, moonlight, like still water, lies across the courtyard and the sleepless traveler's robe.
As if a single night of spring wind had woken ten thousand pear trees into blossom.
At the cock's crow, the moon over the thatched inn, footprints on the frost-covered bridge.
Beneath the white, beside the tears, the weary heart finds peace.

Amid wind and moon, the sun tells a tale that never fades.
Amid white and soul, the wanderer tells a tale that never fades.
With wind, rain, and water, the ancient scene stirs still alive.

Surveying autumn frost, the poet gives voice to the harsh beauty of late life and withered hopes, and what is personal becomes universal in the telling.

Amid spring and wind, the rain tells a tale that never fades.
Amid wind and moon, the flower tells a tale that never fades.
en_translation: A fine rain has been falling all night and shows no sign of stopping at dawn.
A great wind carries the wild geese southward and the poet's thoughts even farther. And so blossoms drift on, water flows on—a single longing felt in two separate places.

As he approach the path ahead, with wine I drown my sorrows.
It is the time when the clouds roll by, and he wander through in quiet thought.
It is the time when the lofty mountains rise, and i think of in quiet thought.
As the traveler think of the path ahead, the wind blows gently.
It is the time when farmers return from the fields at dusk, and the poet linger by in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, I yearn for home and kin while you walk through all around.
Through the passing hours, grief weighs upon my soul while we call to mind all around.
